name: SAMURAI
aliases: Joint optimization of shape, BRDF, cameras, and illuminations
Shape and Material from Unconstrained Real-World Arbitrary Image Collections
definition: A joint optimization framework that estimates 3D shape, BRDF material properties, per-image illumination, camera poses, and camera intrinsics from unconstrained in-the-wild image collections with varying backgrounds and illuminations.
summary: SAMURAI is a joint optimization framework that estimates 3D shape, BRDF, and illumination from unconstrained image collections by decomposing radiance and using a camera multiplex strategy to handle coarse pose annotations.
